RECRUITERS_CLOSE_INVALID: A close request is not valid, so nothing is closed.
RECRUITERS_DEGRADED_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE: The recruiter source was only partly read.
RECRUITERS_NOTION_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: A Notion list did not finish paging.
RECRUITERS_NOTION_QUERY_INCOMPLETE: A Notion query returned an incomplete result.
RECRUITERS_NOTION_ROW_INVALID: A recruiter row is not valid.
RECRUITERS_NOTION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The database no longer has the properties the stage uses.
RECRUITERS_NOTION_SCHEMA_READ_FAILED: The database schema could not be read.
RECRUITERS_READBACK_MISMATCH: A write did not read back as written.
RECRUITERS_RECORDS_FAILED: The recruiter records could not be saved.
RECRUITERS_ROW_NOT_IN_SOURCE: The row is not in the recruiter source.
RECRUITERS_ROW_UNREADABLE: A recruiter row could not be read.
RECRUITERS_STAGE_FAILED: The recruiters stage failed, so the card says so.
ANCHOR_AMBIGUOUS: More than one anchor block matches on the card page.
ANCHOR_GET: Step label: reading the anchor block.
ANCHOR_INVALID: The anchor block is not valid.
AUTOMATION_ADDRESS: Classifier reason: the sender is an automation address.
DIRECT_HUMAN: Classifier class: a direct human message.
FIRST_PERSON: Classifier reason: the sender writes in first person.
HIRING_MANAGER: Classifier reason: the signature names a hiring manager.
HUMAN_NAMED_RELAY: Classifier class: a relay naming a human.
NAME_UNREADABLE: Classifier reason: the sender's name could not be read.
NO_RECRUITER_EVIDENCE: Classifier reason: no sign of a recruiter.
OUTREACH_READBACK_MISMATCH: An outreach write did not read back as written.
OUTREACH_REQUEST_INVALID: The outreach request is not valid.
OUTREACH_SCHEMA_READ_FAILED: The outreach schema could not be read.
RECRUITER_SELF_IDENTIFIED: Classifier reason: the sender says they are a recruiter.
RELAY_NAMED: Classifier reason: a relay that names a person.
RELAY_NAME_UNREADABLE: Classifier reason: a relay whose person could not be read.
RELAY_NOT_A_MESSAGE: Classifier reason: a relay that is not a message.
RELAY_RECRUITING_UNVERIFIED: Classifier reason: a relay whose recruiting could not be verified.
SHAPE_INVALID: The region is not the expected shape.
SOURCE_TOO_MANY: More sources than the card can show.
WRAPPED_IN_CALLOUT: The block sits inside a callout, so it is not touched.
